basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old graphic designer from Portland, Oregon. I have a deep interest in retro gaming and often find myself browsing related subreddits. As an introvert, I prefer quiet evenings with a good book or a classic video game. I'm not very fond of video calls, as I struggle with social anxiety and prefer to communicate through text. I usually log on to Reddit during late evenings after work, around 9 PM to midnight. Currently single, I enjoy my solitude and the comfort of my cozy apartment, where I often experiment with digital art.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Graphic Design from a local college. My love for digital art led me to explore retro aesthetics, which I further developed through self-taught online courses and community feedback. Additionally, I have a growing interest in tech history, particularly the evolution of video game consoles.
